payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 37:1–14 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states ezekiel 37:1–14 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is put within; the wording centers attention on “He brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
